1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __consisting essentially of water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing __genotyping__ of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos, __wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos, and further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __to lyse the shed cellular material__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __to lyse the shed cellular material__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated.

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __from the shed cellular material__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __in stasis storage to achieve a quiescent condition until the outcome of the molecular analysis is known__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping.

14. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant.

16. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __prior to germinating the selected one or more embryos__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using a multi-well plate format__.
